issues.title: Every key press writes an error to the log
issues.note: Its key handler asks the game for a key binding with no name (the "[FancyHandwork]" header of its own list), and the game logs a NullPointerException each time: hundreds a session. The mod works the same. Nothing to do: with the Studio's Live Bridge on, the errors are no longer written.
issues.log: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "zombie.input.KeybindId.getId()" because "keybindID" is null at zombie.core.Core.getKey(Core.java:3023)
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, seen in the game log on 42.21 until 2026-11-02; 2.5.1 still has the same code
